mode: 内置 image_gen：边框底纹合成、色调校正与下沿留白修订
reason: 原先边框由整数GUI像素的填充图元拼合，细节不足。采用约4倍采样的合成图并平滑取样，不再手工绘制边框小菱形与斜纹。
reference: 船坞-GUI-定稿.png 的边框、开发工厂-GUI-定稿.png 的整体配色
render: 左右各48逻辑像素固定尺寸，中央区域适配348／384宽度；边框与底图不分层拼花纹，标题及内容控件仍独立绘制。
outside: 窗口外只显示游戏世界，不增加纹样。
prompts:
Asset: production-ready, high-resolution raster BACKGROUND PANEL for the approved PiranPort Minecraft GUI. Produce a single full-bleed rectangular panel, landscape aspect 32:21 (intended logical size 384x252, at least 4x raster detail, ideally 1536x1008). IMAGE 1 supplies the exact smooth deep-navy diamond backdrop. IMAGE 2 is the approved SHIPYARD mockup and supplies the EXACT ornamental frame style and relative positions. IMAGE 3 is the matching factory GUI context. This is the background panel ONLY: REMOVE ALL text, icons, tabs, slot outlines, lists, buttons, grids, tank, progress arrow and separator lines from the references. Do not paint any functional UI content. Do not paint the title's blue label ribbon or header underline; they will be rendered separately. No scenery, no surrounding margin, no transparency, no outer shadow: the panel's four rectangular edges must coincide with the image edges.
Preserve Image 1's muted navy/slate-blue color range, soft central gradient, broad low-contrast overlapping diamonds and sparse very thin crossing lines; smooth and quiet, no dense grain. Bake a refined, sharply rendered, subtly antialiased version of the SAME frame ornaments in Image 2 directly into this background. Thin cool blue structural edge with nuanced dark inner edge; small top-right horizontal technical glyph, thin outlined short bar, tiny hollow dot and small filled slanted corner piece. Bottom-left: the two prominent parallel solid slanted strips, tiny angular markers and short thin lower-edge technical line with a small diamond endpoint, matching Image 2. Bottom-right: paired diagonal bars, short angular perimeter lines, and three small DOUBLE/INTERLOCKED outline diamonds in a vertical stack just inside the lower-right edge. Match Image 2's sophisticated exact visual character; do not simplify these into crude pixel stairs, tiny ticks or zigzags. Give all diagonal artwork smooth continuous edges and crisp fine detail at 4x detail. Cool dark-teal ornament color approximately #205677, dim detail #173C56, slightly brighter edge highlights, with no neon glow.
Use the 384x252 logical coordinate system for placement: all art wholly INSIDE panel. Top-right decoration fits x=354..380,y=4..17. Bottom-left decoration fits x=4..47,y=220..249. Bottom-right corner art fits x=346..380,y=227..249. Three little diamonds centered about x=378 at y=197,204,211. Keep both 48-logical-pixel side bands as the location of all edge ornamentation; the center contains only the diamond backdrop. Keep side border motifs away from the content field. No ornaments anywhere except these specified inner edges/corners. Preserve broad flat usable center for separately rendered controls. Do not add any text, watermark, emblem, screws, frame bevel depth, decorative circuitry across the center or new visual theme. The result should recreate the approved border/backdrop coordination, while refining the raster precision.

Make a COLOR-ONLY refinement of IMAGE 1, the completed background panel with ornaments. Keep the canvas, ornament shapes, positions and all details exactly unchanged. IMAGE 2 is the intended earlier muted deep navy/slate-blue palette. Restore the large central background field to Image 2's quieter, less saturated steel-blue levels (central approximately #224566 and dark navy edges #0D2034), keeping its large diamonds and gradient visible. The new edge artwork in Image 1 is too electric cyan: tone down its brightness and saturation by about 25–35 percent toward cool dark teal/steel blue, motif fills around #205677 to #286587, fine diamond outlines around #34799D, structural border around #297CA4. Keep enough contrast to read the refined art but eliminate neon-cyan appearance. Preserve every border shape and antialiased edge, no blur of geometry. Do not add or remove anything. Output only the full-bleed panel texture, no UI, no lettering, no margin.

Edit the supplied existing full-bleed GUI background texture with one precise local adjustment only. Preserve the entire 1547x1016 canvas, palette, diamonds, frame, top-right glyph, right-side stacked diamonds, diagonal bars, and all other art exactly. The thin short HORIZONTAL ORNAMENT LINES near the bottom-left and bottom-right corners currently sit around y=984 (about logical y=244), which is too close to overlaid text. Move ONLY these two short horizontal decorative strokes and their little diamond endpoint markers DOWN approximately 16 raster pixels, to y=1000 (logical y=248), just above the outer bottom border at y=1011. Keep their x coordinates and lengths unchanged. Keep the paired diagonal bars stationary, smoothly extend any tiny connecting end as needed. All corner decoration must remain inside the image. Do not move the actual outer bottom structural frame line, do not change any other art, do not add anything. The result needs a clean gap above the little horizontal ornament where text will be overlaid. No lettering or UI controls.
